title:
Some come for the dives.
Some come for the long lunches.
We sail for both.
subtitle: Private sailing trips in La Paz, Baja California Sur, built around your group.
specialLinkLabel: Special editions this November: Sergio Torres and Monik Saab
introTitle: The crew reads the group, not the schedule.
intro: We build private sailing trips around your group, not the other way around. You choose who comes. Our team runs the boat, keeps everyone safe, and reads the day so it can change when something worth changing it for shows up.
expeditionsIntro: Private expeditions on your dates, with the people you choose.
specialTitle: Limited dates with our Expedition Leaders
specialIntro: A few times a year, one of our Expedition Leaders takes a trip around what they know best. Set dates, a small group, and the same way of reading the day as every other expedition.

expeditions.name: Recalibration Expedition
expeditions.builtAround: Built around: slow days on board
expeditions.otherSide: Long lunches on deck, or as much time in the water as you want.
expeditions.imageAlt: A slow moment on board: lunch, shade and a swim off the stern
expeditions.description: A private sailing expedition for people who want to disconnect with their own people, at a pace nobody else is setting. You choose the dates and the group.

expeditions.name: Active Expedition
expeditions.builtAround: Built around: time in the water
expeditions.otherSide: Skip a session, and the long lunch is still on deck.
expeditions.imageAlt: A group in the water with a guide
expeditions.description: More hours in the water: freediving, scuba and long snorkel sessions, with a certified specialist and the gear on board. You choose the dates and the group.

expeditions.name: Your own expedition
expeditions.otherSide: Your dates, your people, your pace.
expeditions.description: Your own trip, built around your group: the dates, the people and what you want from your days at sea.

activitiesTitle: Add activities, or keep the days slow
activitiesSubtitle: Every expedition works with no activities at all. If your group wants more time in the water, our Passionate Sea People are the instructors and specialists behind these. Add them to any expedition, and we'll design it with you.
